topics.description: Federal authorities have unveiled a sweeping Medicaid fraud scheme in Minnesota, alleging $90 million was stolen from taxpayer-funded Medicaid and social service programs. This is part of a larger trend of healthcare fraud investigations in the state.
topics.reason: New developments in a large-scale Medicaid fraud case

topics.description: The 'mastermind' behind the $250 million Feeding Our Future fraud has been sentenced to nearly 42 years in prison. This case highlights the severity of nonprofit fraud in Minnesota.
topics.reason: High-profile sentencing in a large-scale nonprofit fraud case
